  "meta_commentary": "Execution-ready briefing. Land tasks in order \u2014 they're staged to keep each phase independently testable and to surface regressions early.\n\n**Critical landings:**\n- T1+T2 ship first (smallest blast radius, no code-path coupling).\n- T3+T4 must ship together \u2014 `_source_file` stamping is unconditional, and the strip-before-serialize in `export_to_jsonl` is what keeps the flat output byte-identical. Don't merge them separately.\n- T6+T7 are coupled (manifest writer is called from `export_to_shards`).\n- T8+T9 are coupled (push uses card v2).\n- T10 depends on T7's manifest shape.\n\n**FLAG-001 is the one technical landmine:** `huggingface_hub.HfApi.upload_folder` calls `huggingface_hub.utils.filter_repo_objects(allow_patterns=..., ignore_patterns=...)` which AND-filters \u2014 a path must be in `allow_patterns` AND NOT in `ignore_patterns`. The original `ignore_patterns=['.dataclaw/*']` would silently drop the manifest from the upload. Use `ignore_patterns=['conversations.jsonl']` ONLY. T11's `test_push_shards_manifest_survives_filter_repo_objects` calls the real `filter_repo_objects` to lock the invariant.\n\n**Byte-for-byte invariant:** T5 includes a SHA-256 comparison test for `export_to_jsonl`. If you see any drift, it's almost certainly because an underscore-prefixed key leaked into the JSON or the field ordering changed. The strip dict comprehension `{k: v for k, v in session.items() if not k.startswith('_')}` preserves Python 3.7+ insertion order \u2014 same as before.\n\n**OpenCode quirk:** Per the design, `_source_file = OPENCODE_DB_PATH` (whole DB file) \u2014 over-cools when other sessions in the DB are active, but never under-cools. Don't try to \"fix\" this to per-session mtime; T5 explicitly tests for the over-cool behavior.\n\n**Pre-existing test fragility:** T3 changes the contract \u2014 sessions with `end_time=None` are now dropped. Run the full pre-existing suite after T3 and update (don't delete) any test that seeded `end_time=None` and expected survival.\n\n**`AUTO_MODE_STEPS`:** Empty-list stub only in this plan. Phase 5 populates it. Don't reference its contents in any Phase 1\u20133 help/copy strings.\n\n**Mask scope:** Only `redact_strings` is masked by `_mask_config_for_display`. `redact_usernames` and `excluded_projects` are NOT secret-sensitive \u2014 leave them visible. `--show-secrets` flips ONLY the redact-strings masking.\n\n**Manifest path layout assumption (open question #1):** `{bucket/}{source}/{YYYY-MM-DD}.jsonl` when bucket is set; `{source}/{YYYY-MM-DD}.jsonl` otherwise. Proceed under this assumption \u2014 the plan's success criteria depend on it.\n\n**Library-only in Phases 1\u20133 (open question #2):** `export_to_shards` is NOT wired to a CLI flag in this plan. It's a library function consumed by tests now and by `dataclaw auto` in Phase 5.\n\n**Manual smoke acceptable but not required:** The OpenCode 24h-boundary REPL smoke and the masking smoke are listed as `info` priority \u2014 covered by automated tests; only run manually if a quick gut-check is desired before merging.\n\n**Watch the cli.py size:** It's already 1638 lines (DEBT flagged). This plan adds materially more behavior. Use named helpers liberally to avoid one-off ballooning of `confirm` and `export_to_shards` bodies. `export_to_shards` should stay under ~120 lines.",

  "meta_commentary": "Execution-ready briefing. Land tasks in order \u2014 they're staged to keep each phase independently testable and to surface regressions early.\n\n**Critical landings:**\n- T1+T2 ship first (smallest blast radius, no code-path coupling).\n- T3+T4 must ship together \u2014 `_source_file` stamping is unconditional, and the strip-before-serialize in `export_to_jsonl` is what keeps the flat output byte-identical. Don't merge them separately.\n- T6+T7 are coupled (manifest writer is called from `export_to_shards`).\n- T8+T9 are coupled (push uses card v2).\n- T10 depends on T7's manifest shape.\n\n**FLAG-001 is the one technical landmine:** `huggingface_hub.HfApi.upload_folder` calls `huggingface_hub.utils.filter_repo_objects(allow_patterns=..., ignore_patterns=...)` which AND-filters \u2014 a path must be in `allow_patterns` AND NOT in `ignore_patterns`. The original `ignore_patterns=['.dataclaw/*']` would silently drop the manifest from the upload. Use `ignore_patterns=['conversations.jsonl']` ONLY. T11's `test_push_shards_manifest_survives_filter_repo_objects` calls the real `filter_repo_objects` to lock the invariant.\n\n**Byte-for-byte invariant:** T5 includes a SHA-256 comparison test for `export_to_jsonl`. If you see any drift, it's almost certainly because an underscore-prefixed key leaked into the JSON or the field ordering changed. The strip dict comprehension `{k: v for k, v in session.items() if not k.startswith('_')}` preserves Python 3.7+ insertion order \u2014 same as before.\n\n**OpenCode quirk:** Per the design, `_source_file = OPENCODE_DB_PATH` (whole DB file) \u2014 over-cools when other sessions in the DB are active, but never under-cools. Don't try to \"fix\" this to per-session mtime; T5 explicitly tests for the over-cool behavior.\n\n**Pre-existing test fragility:** T3 changes the contract \u2014 sessions with `end_time=None` are now dropped. Run the full pre-existing suite after T3 and update (don't delete) any test that seeded `end_time=None` and expected survival.\n\n**`AUTO_MODE_STEPS`:** Empty-list stub only in this plan. Phase 5 populates it. Don't reference its contents in any Phase 1\u20133 help/copy strings.\n\n**Mask scope:** Only `redact_strings` is masked by `_mask_config_for_display`. `redact_usernames` and `excluded_projects` are NOT secret-sensitive \u2014 leave them visible. `--show-secrets` flips ONLY the redact-strings masking.\n\n**Manifest path layout assumption (open question #1):** `{bucket/}{source}/{YYYY-MM-DD}.jsonl` when bucket is set; `{source}/{YYYY-MM-DD}.jsonl` otherwise. Proceed under this assumption \u2014 the plan's success criteria depend on it.\n\n**Library-only in Phases 1\u20133 (open question #2):** `export_to_shards` is NOT wired to a CLI flag in this plan. It's a library function consumed by tests now and by `dataclaw auto` in Phase 5.\n\n**Manual smoke acceptable but not required:** The OpenCode 24h-boundary REPL smoke and the masking smoke are listed as `info` priority \u2014 covered by automated tests; only run manually if a quick gut-check is desired before merging.\n\n**Watch the cli.py size:** It's already 1638 lines (DEBT flagged). This plan adds materially more behavior. Use named helpers liberally to avoid one-off ballooning of `confirm` and `export_to_shards` bodies. `export_to_shards` should stay under ~120 lines.",

        Debt watch items (do not make these worse):
- [DEBT] are-the-proposed-changes-technically-correct: are the proposed changes technically correct?: inspected `../runpod-lifecycle/src/runpod_lifecycle/pod.py` and `../runpod-lifecycle/src/runpod_lifecycle/ssh.py`. the existing `_build_ssh_client()` helper returns the package's own `runpod_lifecycle.ssh.sshclient` wrapper, not a raw `paramiko.sshclient`. that means step 0's promise that `pod.open_ssh_client() -> paramiko.sshclient` is a 3-line public wrapper around existing logic is not technically accurate, and step 20's `scp.scpclient(ssh.get_transport())` call would not work against the current wrapper type as written. (flagged 1 times across 1 plans)
- [DEBT] are-the-proposed-changes-technically-correct: are the proposed changes technically correct?: checked `runpodconfig.from_env()` in `../runpod-lifecycle/src/runpod_lifecycle/config.py`. it parses `runpod_ssh_private_key`, `runpod_ssh_private_key_path`, and related key vars, but it does not consume `runpod_ssh_password`; the current password path comes from pod ssh details inside `_build_ssh_client()`. the fallback clause therefore misstates the existing config surface when it says it reads the same env vars that `runpodconfig.from_env()` already consumes. (flagged 1 times across 1 plans)
- [DEBT] are-the-proposed-changes-technically-correct: are the proposed changes technically correct?: checked the hugging face dependency currently installed with the repository: huggingface_hub 0.36.2 exposes entrynotfounderror, repositorynotfounderror, localentrynotfounderror, and hfhubhttperror. the plan's step 6 says a 404/not-found target shard should continue and the test stubs repositorynotfounderror, but a missing file in an existing dataset is represented by entrynotfounderror in this api family; if implementation only catches repositorynotfounderror, first-time shard paths in an existing repo can abort instead of being treated as empty. (flagged 1 times across 1 plans)

mtime) >= COOL_DOWN_SECONDS\n+\n+\n+def _latest_mtime_path(paths: list[Path]) -> Path | None:\n+    existing = [p for p in paths if p.exists()]\n+    if not existing:\n+        return None\n+    return max(existing, key=lambda p: p.stat().st_mtime)\n+\n+\n+def _apply_session_filters(\n+    sessions: list[dict],\n+    *,\n+    cooled_only: bool,\n+    since: dict[str, str] | None,\n+    source: str,\n+) -> list[dict]:\n+    filtered = []\n+    cutoff_cache: dict[str, datetime | None] = {}\n+    for session in sessions:\n+        end_time = _parse_iso(session.get(\"end_time\"))\n+        if end_time is None:\n+            logger.debug(\n+                \"Skipping %s session %s with unparseable end_time\",\n+                session.get(\"source\", source),\n+                session.get(\"session_id\"),\n+            )\n+            continue\n+\n+        if cooled_only and not _is_cooled_path(session.get(\"_source_file\")):\n+            continue\n+\n+        source_key = session.get(\"source\", source)\n+        cutoff = None\n+        if since:\n+            if source_key not in cutoff_cache:\n+                cutoff_cache[source_key] = _parse_iso(since.get(source_key))\n+            cutoff = cutoff_cache[source_key]\n+        if cutoff is not None and end_time <= cutoff:\n+            continue\n+\n+        filtered.append(session)\n+    return filtered\n+\n+\n def _build_gemini_hash_map() -> dict[str, str]:\n*** End Patch\n"

  "meta_commentary": "Execution-ready briefing. Land tasks in order \u2014 they're staged to keep each phase independently testable and to surface regressions early.\n\n**Critical landings:**\n- T1+T2 ship first (smallest blast radius, no code-path coupling).\n- T3+T4 must ship together \u2014 `_source_file` stamping is unconditional, and the strip-before-serialize in `export_to_jsonl` is what keeps the flat output byte-identical. Don't merge them separately.\n- T6+T7 are coupled (manifest writer is called from `export_to_shards`).\n- T8+T9 are coupled (push uses card v2).\n- T10 depends on T7's manifest shape.\n\n**FLAG-001 is the one technical landmine:** `huggingface_hub.HfApi.upload_folder` calls `huggingface_hub.utils.filter_repo_objects(allow_patterns=..., ignore_patterns=...)` which AND-filters \u2014 a path must be in `allow_patterns` AND NOT in `ignore_patterns`. The original `ignore_patterns=['.dataclaw/*']` would silently drop the manifest from the upload. Use `ignore_patterns=['conversations.jsonl']` ONLY. T11's `test_push_shards_manifest_survives_filter_repo_objects` calls the real `filter_repo_objects` to lock the invariant.\n\n**Byte-for-byte invariant:** T5 includes a SHA-256 comparison test for `export_to_jsonl`. If you see any drift, it's almost certainly because an underscore-prefixed key leaked into the JSON or the field ordering changed.   "meta_commentary": "Execution-ready briefing. Land tasks in order \u2014 they're staged to keep each phase independently testable and to surface regressions early.\n\n**Critical landings:**\n- T1+T2 ship first (smallest blast radius, no code-path coupling).\n- T3+T4 must ship together \u2014 `_source_file` stamping is unconditional, and the strip-before-serialize in `export_to_jsonl` is what keeps the flat output byte-identical. Don't merge them separately.\n- T6+T7 are coupled (manifest writer is called from `export_to_shards`).\n- T8+T9 are coupled (push uses card v2).\n- T10 depends on T7's manifest shape.\n\n**FLAG-001 is the one technical landmine:** `huggingface_hub.HfApi.upload_folder` calls `huggingface_hub.utils.filter_repo_objects(allow_patterns=..., ignore_patterns=...)` which AND-filters \u2014 a path must be in `allow_patterns` AND NOT in `ignore_patterns`. The original `ignore_patterns=['.dataclaw/*']` would silently drop the manifest from the upload. Use `ignore_patterns=['conversations.jsonl']` ONLY. T11's `test_push_shards_manifest_survives_filter_repo_objects` calls the real `filter_repo_objects` to lock the invariant.\n\n**Byte-for-byte invariant:** T5 includes a SHA-256 comparison test for `export_to_jsonl`. If you see any drift, it's almost certainly because an underscore-prefixed key leaked into the JSON or the field ordering changed. The strip dict comprehension `{k: v for k, v in session.items() if not k.startswith('_')}` preserves Python 3.7+ insertion order \u2014 same as before.\n\n**OpenCode quirk:** Per the design, `_source_file = OPENCODE_DB_PATH` (whole DB file) \u2014 over-cools when other sessions in the DB are active, but never under-cools. Don't try to \"fix\" this to per-session mtime; T5 explicitly tests for the over-cool behavior.\n\n**Pre-existing test fragility:** T3 changes the contract \u2014 sessions with `end_time=None` are now dropped. Run the full pre-existing suite after T3 and update (don't delete) any test that seeded `end_time=None` and expected survival.\n\n**`AUTO_MODE_STEPS`:** Empty-list stub only in this plan. Phase 5 populates it. Don't reference its contents in any Phase 1\u20133 help/copy strings.\n\n**Mask scope:** Only `redact_strings` is masked by `_mask_config_for_display`. `redact_usernames` and `excluded_projects` are NOT secret-sensitive \u2014 leave them visible. `--show-secrets` flips ONLY the redact-strings masking.\n\n**Manifest path layout assumption (open question #1):** `{bucket/}{source}/{YYYY-MM-DD}.jsonl` when bucket is set; `{source}/{YYYY-MM-DD}.jsonl` otherwise. Proceed under this assumption \u2014 the plan's success criteria depend on it.\n\n**Library-only in Phases 1\u20133 (open question #2):** `export_to_shards` is NOT wired to a CLI flag in this plan. It's a library function consumed by tests now and by `dataclaw auto` in Phase 5.\n\n**Manual smoke acceptable but not required:** The OpenCode 24h-boundary REPL smoke and the masking smoke are listed as `info` priority \u2014 covered by automated tests; only run manually if a quick gut-check is desired before merging.\n\n**Watch the cli.py size:** It's already 1638 lines (DEBT flagged). This plan adds materially more behavior. Use named helpers liberally to avoid one-off ballooning of `confirm` and `export_to_shards` bodies. `export_to_shards` should stay under ~120 lines.",

  "meta_commentary": "Execution-ready briefing. Land tasks in order \u2014 they're staged to keep each phase independently testable and to surface regressions early.\n\n**Critical landings:**\n- T1+T2 ship first (smallest blast radius, no code-path coupling).\n- T3+T4 must ship together \u2014 `_source_file` stamping is unconditional, and the strip-before-serialize in `export_to_jsonl` is what keeps the flat output byte-identical. Don't merge them separately.\n- T6+T7 are coupled (manifest writer is called from `export_to_shards`).\n- T8+T9 are coupled (push uses card v2).\n- T10 depends on T7's manifest shape.\n\n**FLAG-001 is the one technical landmine:** `huggingface_hub.HfApi.upload_folder` calls `huggingface_hub.utils.filter_repo_objects(allow_patterns=..., ignore_patterns=...)` which AND-filters \u2014 a path must be in `allow_patterns` AND NOT in `ignore_patterns`. The original `ignore_patterns=['.dataclaw/*']` would silently drop the manifest from the upload. Use `ignore_patterns=['conversations.jsonl']` ONLY. T11's `test_push_shards_manifest_survives_filter_repo_objects` calls the real `filter_repo_objects` to lock the invariant.\n\n**Byte-for-byte invariant:** T5 includes a SHA-256 comparison test for `export_to_jsonl`. If you see any drift, it's almost certainly because an underscore-prefixed key leaked into the JSON or the field ordering changed. The strip dict comprehension `{k: v for k, v in session.items() if not k.startswith('_')}` preserves Python 3.7+ insertion order \u2014 same as before.\n\n**OpenCode quirk:** Per the design, `_source_file = OPENCODE_DB_PATH` (whole DB file) \u2014 over-cools when other sessions in the DB are active, but never under-cools. Don't try to \"fix\" this to per-session mtime; T5 explicitly tests for the over-cool behavior.\n\n**Pre-existing test fragility:** T3 changes the contract \u2014 sessions with `end_time=None` are now dropped. Run the full pre-existing suite after T3 and update (don't delete) any test that seeded `end_time=None` and expected survival.\n\n**`AUTO_MODE_STEPS`:** Empty-list stub only in this plan. Phase 5 populates it. Don't reference its contents in any Phase 1\u20133 help/copy strings.\n\n**Mask scope:** Only `redact_strings` is masked by `_mask_config_for_display`. `redact_usernames` and `excluded_projects` are NOT secret-sensitive \u2014 leave them visible. `--show-secrets` flips ONLY the redact-strings masking.\n\n**Manifest path layout assumption (open question #1):** `{bucket/}{source}/{YYYY-MM-DD}.jsonl` when bucket is set; `{source}/{YYYY-MM-DD}.jsonl` otherwise. Proceed under this assumption \u2014 the plan's success criteria depend on it.\n\n**Library-only in Phases 1\u20133 (open question #2):** `export_to_shards` is NOT wired to a CLI flag in this plan. It's a library function consumed by tests now and by `dataclaw auto` in Phase 5.\n\n**Manual smoke acceptable but not required:** The OpenCode 24h-boundary REPL smoke and the masking smoke are listed as `info` priority \u2014 covered by automated tests; only run manually if a quick gut-check is desired before merging.\n\n**Watch the cli.py size:** It's already 1638 lines (DEBT flagged). This plan adds materially more behavior. Use named helpers liberally to avoid one-off ballooning of `confirm` and `export_to_shards` bodies. `export_to_shards` should stay under ~120 lines.",

  "meta_commentary": "Execution-ready briefing. Land tasks in order \u2014 they're staged to keep each phase independently testable and to surface regressions early.\n\n**Critical landings:**\n- T1+T2 ship first (smallest blast radius, no code-path coupling).\n- T3+T4 must ship together \u2014 `_source_file` stamping is unconditional, and the strip-before-serialize in `export_to_jsonl` is what keeps the flat output byte-identical. Don't merge them separately.\n- T6+T7 are coupled (manifest writer is called from `export_to_shards`).\n- T8+T9 are coupled (push uses card v2).\n- T10 depends on T7's manifest shape.\n\n**FLAG-001 is the one technical landmine:** `huggingface_hub.HfApi.upload_folder` calls `huggingface_hub.utils.filter_repo_objects(allow_patterns=..., ignore_patterns=...)` which AND-filters \u2014 a path must be in `allow_patterns` AND NOT in `ignore_patterns`. The original `ignore_patterns=['.dataclaw/*']` would silently drop the manifest from the upload. Use `ignore_patterns=['conversations.jsonl']` ONLY. T11's `test_push_shards_manifest_survives_filter_repo_objects` calls the real `filter_repo_objects` to lock the invariant.\n\n**Byte-for-byte invariant:** T5 includes a SHA-256 comparison test for `export_to_jsonl`. If you see any drift, it's almost certainly because an underscore-prefixed key leaked into the JSON or the field ordering changed. The strip dict comprehension `{k: v for k, v in session.items() if not k.startswith('_')}` preserves Python 3.7+ insertion order \u2014 same as before.\n\n**OpenCode quirk:** Per the design, `_source_file = OPENCODE_DB_PATH` (whole DB file) \u2014 over-cools when other sessions in the DB are active, but never under-cools. Don't try to \"fix\" this to per-session mtime; T5 explicitly tests for the over-cool behavior.\n\n**Pre-existing test fragility:** T3 changes the contract \u2014 sessions with `end_time=None` are now dropped.   "meta_commentary": "Execution-ready briefing. Land tasks in order \u2014 they're staged to keep each phase independently testable and to surface regressions early.\n\n**Critical landings:**\n- T1+T2 ship first (smallest blast radius, no code-path coupling).\n- T3+T4 must ship together \u2014 `_source_file` stamping is unconditional, and the strip-before-serialize in `export_to_jsonl` is what keeps the flat output byte-identical. Don't merge them separately.\n- T6+T7 are coupled (manifest writer is called from `export_to_shards`).\n- T8+T9 are coupled (push uses card v2).\n- T10 depends on T7's manifest shape.\n\n**FLAG-001 is the one technical landmine:** `huggingface_hub.HfApi.upload_folder` calls `huggingface_hub.utils.filter_repo_objects(allow_patterns=..., ignore_patterns=...)` which AND-filters \u2014 a path must be in `allow_patterns` AND NOT in `ignore_patterns`. The original `ignore_patterns=['.dataclaw/*']` would silently drop the manifest from the upload. Use `ignore_patterns=['conversations.jsonl']` ONLY. T11's `test_push_shards_manifest_survives_filter_repo_objects` calls the real `filter_repo_objects` to lock the invariant.\n\n**Byte-for-byte invariant:** T5 includes a SHA-256 comparison test for `export_to_jsonl`. If you see any drift, it's almost certainly because an underscore-prefixed key leaked into the JSON or the field ordering changed. The strip dict comprehension `{k: v for k, v in session.items() if not k.startswith('_')}` preserves Python 3.7+ insertion order \u2014 same as before.\n\n**OpenCode quirk:** Per the design, `_source_file = OPENCODE_DB_PATH` (whole DB file) \u2014 over-cools when other sessions in the DB are active, but never under-cools. Don't try to \"fix\" this to per-session mtime; T5 explicitly tests for the over-cool behavior.\n\n**Pre-existing test fragility:** T3 changes the contract \u2014 sessions with `end_time=None` are now dropped. Run the full pre-existing suite after T3 and update (don't delete) any test that seeded `end_time=None` and expected survival.\n\n**`AUTO_MODE_STEPS`:** Empty-list stub only in this plan. Phase 5 populates it. Don't reference its contents in any Phase 1\u20133 help/copy strings.\n\n**Mask scope:** Only `redact_strings` is masked by `_mask_config_for_display`. `redact_usernames` and `excluded_projects` are NOT secret-sensitive \u2014 leave them visible. `--show-secrets` flips ONLY the redact-strings masking.\n\n**Manifest path layout assumption (open question #1):** `{bucket/}{source}/{YYYY-MM-DD}.jsonl` when bucket is set; `{source}/{YYYY-MM-DD}.jsonl` otherwise. Proceed under this assumption \u2014 the plan's success criteria depend on it.\n\n**Library-only in Phases 1\u20133 (open question #2):** `export_to_shards` is NOT wired to a CLI flag in this plan. It's a library function consumed by tests now and by `dataclaw auto` in Phase 5.\n\n**Manual smoke acceptable but not required:** The OpenCode 24h-boundary REPL smoke and the masking smoke are listed as `info` priority \u2014 covered by automated tests; only run manually if a quick gut-check is desired before merging.\n\n**Watch the cli.py size:** It's already 1638 lines (DEBT flagged). This plan adds materially more behavior. Use named helpers liberally to avoid one-off ballooning of `confirm` and `export_to_shards` bodies. `export_to_shards` should stay under ~120 lines.",

        Debt watch items (do not make these worse):
- [DEBT] are-the-proposed-changes-technically-correct: are the proposed changes technically correct?: inspected `../runpod-lifecycle/src/runpod_lifecycle/pod.py` and `../runpod-lifecycle/src/runpod_lifecycle/ssh.py`. the existing `_build_ssh_client()` helper returns the package's own `runpod_lifecycle.ssh.sshclient` wrapper, not a raw `paramiko.sshclient`. that means step 0's promise that `pod.open_ssh_client() -> paramiko.sshclient` is a 3-line public wrapper around existing logic is not technically accurate, and step 20's `scp.scpclient(ssh.get_transport())` call would not work against the current wrapper type as written. (flagged 1 times across 1 plans)
- [DEBT] are-the-proposed-changes-technically-correct: are the proposed changes technically correct?: checked `runpodconfig.from_env()` in `../runpod-lifecycle/src/runpod_lifecycle/config.py`. it parses `runpod_ssh_private_key`, `runpod_ssh_private_key_path`, and related key vars, but it does not consume `runpod_ssh_password`; the current password path comes from pod ssh details inside `_build_ssh_client()`. the fallback clause therefore misstates the existing config surface when it says it reads the same env vars that `runpodconfig.from_env()` already consumes. (flagged 1 times across 1 plans)
- [DEBT] are-the-proposed-changes-technically-correct: are the proposed changes technically correct?: checked the hugging face dependency currently installed with the repository: huggingface_hub 0.36.2 exposes entrynotfounderror, repositorynotfounderror, localentrynotfounderror, and hfhubhttperror. the plan's step 6 says a 404/not-found target shard should continue and the test stubs repositorynotfounderror, but a missing file in an existing dataset is represented by entrynotfounderror in this api family; if implementation only catches repositorynotfounderror, first-time shard paths in an existing repo can abort instead of being treated as empty. (flagged 1 times across 1 plans)
- [DEBT] blocked-auto-review-command: blocked auto review command: plan tells users to run `dataclaw confirm <run_dir>` without specifying the required argparse positional path change. (flagged 1 times across 1 plans)

  "meta_commentary": "Execution-ready briefing. Land tasks in order \u2014 they're staged to keep each phase independently testable and to surface regressions early.\n\n**Critical landings:**\n- T1+T2 ship first (smallest blast radius, no code-path coupling).\n- T3+T4 must ship together \u2014 `_source_file` stamping is unconditional, and the strip-before-serialize in `export_to_jsonl` is what keeps the flat output byte-identical. Don't merge them separately.\n- T6+T7 are coupled (manifest writer is called from `export_to_shards`).\n- T8+T9 are coupled (push uses card v2).\n- T10 depends on T7's manifest shape.\n\n**FLAG-001 is the one technical landmine:** `huggingface_hub.HfApi.upload_folder` calls `huggingface_hub.utils.filter_repo_objects(allow_patterns=..., ignore_patterns=...)` which AND-filters \u2014 a path must be in `allow_patterns` AND NOT in `ignore_patterns`. The original `ignore_patterns=['.dataclaw/*']` would silently drop the manifest from the upload. Use `ignore_patterns=['conversations.jsonl']` ONLY. T11's `test_push_shards_manifest_survives_filter_repo_objects` calls the real `filter_repo_objects` to lock the invariant.\n\n**Byte-for-byte invariant:** T5 includes a SHA-256 comparison test for `export_to_jsonl`. If you see any drift, it's almost certainly because an underscore-prefixed key leaked into the JSON or the field ordering changed. The strip dict comprehension `{k: v for k, v in session.items() if not k.startswith('_')}` preserves Python 3.7+ insertion order \u2014 same as before.\n\n**OpenCode quirk:** Per the design, `_source_file = OPENCODE_DB_PATH` (whole DB file) \u2014 over-cools when other sessions in the DB are active, but never under-cools. Don't try to \"fix\" this to per-session mtime; T5 explicitly tests for the over-cool behavior.\n\n**Pre-existing test fragility:** T3 changes the contract \u2014 sessions with `end_time=None` are now dropped. Run the full pre-existing suite after T3 and update (don't delete) any test that seeded `end_time=None` and expected survival.\n\n**`AUTO_MODE_STEPS`:** Empty-list stub only in this plan. Phase 5 populates it. Don't reference its contents in any Phase 1\u20133 help/copy strings.\n\n**Mask scope:** Only `redact_strings` is masked by `_mask_config_for_display`. `redact_usernames` and `excluded_projects` are NOT secret-sensitive \u2014 leave them visible. `--show-secrets` flips ONLY the redact-strings masking.\n\n**Manifest path layout assumption (open question #1):** `{bucket/}{source}/{YYYY-MM-DD}.jsonl` when bucket is set; `{source}/{YYYY-MM-DD}.jsonl` otherwise. Proceed under this assumption \u2014 the plan's success criteria depend on it.\n\n**Library-only in Phases 1\u20133 (open question #2):** `export_to_shards` is NOT wired to a CLI flag in this plan. It's a library function consumed by tests now and by `dataclaw auto` in Phase 5.\n\n**Manual smoke acceptable but not required:** The OpenCode 24h-boundary REPL smoke and the masking smoke are listed as `info` priority \u2014 covered by automated tests; only run manually if a quick gut-check is desired before merging.\n\n**Watch the cli.py size:** It's already 1638 lines (DEBT flagged). This plan adds materially more behavior. Use named helpers liberally to avoid one-off ballooning of `confirm` and `export_to_shards` bodies. `export_to_shards` should stay under ~120 lines.",

  "meta_commentary": "Execution-ready briefing. Land tasks in order \u2014 they're staged to keep each phase independently testable and to surface regressions early.\n\n**Critical landings:**\n- T1+T2 ship first (smallest blast radius, no code-path coupling).\n- T3+T4 must ship together \u2014 `_source_file` stamping is unconditional, and the strip-before-serialize in `export_to_jsonl` is what keeps the flat output byte-identical. Don't merge them separately.\n- T6+T7 are coupled (manifest writer is called from `export_to_shards`).\n- T8+T9 are coupled (push uses card v2).\n- T10 depends on T7's manifest shape.\n\n**FLAG-001 is the one technical landmine:** `huggingface_hub.HfApi.upload_folder` calls `huggingface_hub.utils.filter_repo_objects(allow_patterns=..., ignore_patterns=...)` which AND-filters \u2014 a path must be in `allow_patterns` AND NOT in `ignore_patterns`. The original `ignore_patterns=['.dataclaw/*']` would silently drop the manifest from the upload. Use `ignore_patterns=['conversations.jsonl']` ONLY. T11's `test_push_shards_manifest_survives_filter_repo_objects` calls the real `filter_repo_objects` to lock the invariant.\n\n**Byte-for-byte invariant:** T5 includes a SHA-256 comparison test for `export_to_jsonl`. If you see any drift, it's almost certainly because an underscore-prefixed key leaked into the JSON or the field ordering changed. The strip dict comprehension `{k: v for k, v in session.items() if not k.startswith('_')}` preserves Python 3.7+ insertion order \u2014 same as before.\n\n**OpenCode quirk:** Per the design, `_source_file = OPENCODE_DB_PATH` (whole DB file) \u2014 over-cools when other sessions in the DB are active, but never under-cools. Don't try to \"fix\" this to per-session mtime; T5 explicitly tests for the over-cool behavior.\n\n**Pre-existing test fragility:** T3 changes the contract \u2014 sessions with `end_time=None` are now dropped. Run the full pre-existing suite after T3 and update (don't delete) any test that seeded `end_time=None` and expected survival.\n\n**`AUTO_MODE_STEPS`:** Empty-list stub only in this plan. Phase 5 populates it. Don't reference its contents in any Phase 1\u20133 help/copy strings.\n\n**Mask scope:** Only `redact_strings` is masked by `_mask_config_for_display`. `redact_usernames` and `excluded_projects` are NOT secret-sensitive \u2014 leave them visible. `--show-secrets` flips ONLY the redact-strings masking.\n\n**Manifest path layout assumption (open question #1):** `{bucket/}{source}/{YYYY-MM-DD}.jsonl` when bucket is set; `{source}/{YYYY-MM-DD}.jsonl` otherwise. Proceed under this assumption \u2014 the plan's success criteria depend on it.\n\n**Library-only in Phases 1\u20133 (open question #2):** `export_to_shards` is NOT wired to a CLI flag in this plan. It's a library function consumed by tests now and by `dataclaw auto` in Phase 5.\n\n**Manual smoke acceptable but not required:** The OpenCode 24h-boundary REPL smoke and the masking smoke are listed as `info` priority \u2014 covered by automated tests; only run manually if a quick gut-check is desired before merging.\n\n**Watch the cli.py size:** It's already 1638 lines (DEBT flagged). This plan adds materially more behavior. Use named helpers liberally to avoid one-off ballooning of `confirm` and `export_to_shards` bodies. `export_to_shards` should stay under ~120 lines.",

        Debt watch items (do not make these worse):
- [DEBT] are-the-proposed-changes-technically-correct: are the proposed changes technically correct?: inspected `../runpod-lifecycle/src/runpod_lifecycle/pod.py` and `../runpod-lifecycle/src/runpod_lifecycle/ssh.py`. the existing `_build_ssh_client()` helper returns the package's own `runpod_lifecycle.ssh.sshclient` wrapper, not a raw `paramiko.sshclient`. that means step 0's promise that `pod.open_ssh_client() -> paramiko.sshclient` is a 3-line public wrapper around existing logic is not technically accurate, and step 20's `scp.scpclient(ssh.get_transport())` call would not work against the current wrapper type as written. (flagged 1 times across 1 plans)
- [DEBT] are-the-proposed-changes-technically-correct: are the proposed changes technically correct?: checked `runpodconfig.from_env()` in `../runpod-lifecycle/src/runpod_lifecycle/config.py`. it parses `runpod_ssh_private_key`, `runpod_ssh_private_key_path`, and related key vars, but it does not consume `runpod_ssh_password`; the current password path comes from pod ssh details inside `_build_ssh_client()`. the fallback clause therefore misstates the existing config surface when it says it reads the same env vars that `runpodconfig.from_env()` already consumes. (flagged 1 times across 1 plans)
- [DEBT] are-the-proposed-changes-technically-correct: are the proposed changes technically correct?: checked the hugging face dependency currently installed with the repository: huggingface_hub 0.36.2 exposes entrynotfounderror, repositorynotfounderror, localentrynotfounderror, and hfhubhttperror. the plan's step 6 says a 404/not-found target shard should continue and the test stubs repositorynotfounderror, but a missing file in an existing dataset is represented by entrynotfounderror in this api family; if implementation only catches repositorynotfounderror, first-time shard paths in an existing repo can abort instead of being treated as empty. (flagged 1 times across 1 plans)
- [DEBT] blocked-auto-review-command: blocked auto review command: plan tells users to run `dataclaw confirm <run_dir>` without specifying the required argparse positional path change. (flagged 1 times across 1 plans)
- [DEBT] cli-growth: cli growth: plan assigns most new command behavior to an already-large dataclaw/cli.py despite its own manageability criterion. (flagged 1 times across 1 plans)
- [DEBT] code-organization: dataclaw/cli.py is 1638 lines; plan adds significant new command behavior to it. (flagged 1 times across 1 plans)

Land tasks in order \u2014 they're staged to keep each phase independently testable and to surface regressions early.\n\n**Critical landings:**\n- T1+T2 ship first (smallest blast radius, no code-path coupling).\n- T3+T4 must ship together \u2014 `_source_file` stamping is unconditional, and the strip-before-serialize in `export_to_jsonl` is what keeps the flat output byte-identical. Don't merge them separately.\n- T6+T7 are coupled (manifest writer is called from `export_to_shards`).\n- T8+T9 are coupled (push uses card v2).\n- T10 depends on T7's manifest shape.\n\n**FLAG-001 is the one technical landmine:** `huggingface_hub.HfApi.upload_folder` calls `huggingface_hub.utils.filter_repo_objects(allow_patterns=..., ignore_patterns=...)` which AND-filters \u2014 a path must be in `allow_patterns` AND NOT in `ignore_patterns`. The original `ignore_patterns=['.dataclaw/*']` would silently drop the manifest from the upload. Use `ignore_patterns=['conversations.jsonl']` ONLY. T11's `test_push_shards_manifest_survives_filter_repo_objects` calls the real `filter_repo_objects` to lock the invariant.\n\n**Byte-for-byte invariant:** T5 includes a SHA-256 comparison test for `export_to_jsonl`. If you see any drift, it's almost certainly because an underscore-prefixed key leaked into the JSON or the field ordering changed. The strip dict comprehension `{k: v for k, v in session.items() if not k.startswith('_')}` preserves Python 3.7+ insertion order \u2014 same as before.\n\n**OpenCode quirk:** Per the design, `_source_file = OPENCODE_DB_PATH` (whole DB file) \u2014 over-cools when other sessions in the DB are active, but never under-cools. Don't try to \"fix\" this to per-session mtime; T5 explicitly tests for the over-cool behavior.\n\n**Pre-existing test fragility:** T3 changes the contract \u2014 sessions with `end_time=None` are now dropped. Run the full pre-existing suite after T3 and update (don't delete) any test that seeded `end_time=None` and expected survival.\n\n**`AUTO_MODE_STEPS`:** Empty-list stub only in this plan. Phase 5 populates it. Don't reference its contents in any Phase 1\u20133 help/copy strings.\n\n**Mask scope:** Only `redact_strings` is masked by `_mask_config_for_display`. `redact_usernames` and `excluded_projects` are NOT secret-sensitive \u2014 leave them visible. `--show-secrets` flips ONLY the redact-strings masking.\n\n**Manifest path layout assumption (open question #1):** `{bucket/}{source}/{YYYY-MM-DD}.jsonl` when bucket is set; `{source}/{YYYY-MM-DD}.jsonl` otherwise. Proceed under this assumption \u2014 the plan's success criteria depend on it.\n\n**Library-only in Phases 1\u20133 (open question #2):** `export_to_shards` is NOT wired to a CLI flag in this plan. It's a library function consumed by tests now and by `dataclaw auto` in Phase 5.\n\n**Manual smoke acceptable but not required:** The OpenCode 24h-boundary REPL smoke and the masking smoke are listed as `info` priority \u2014 covered by automated tests; only run manually if a quick gut-check is desired before merging.\n\n**Watch the cli.py size:** It's already 1638 lines (DEBT flagged). This plan adds materially more behavior. Use named helpers liberally to avoid one-off ballooning of `confirm` and `export_to_shards` bodies. `export_to_shards` should stay under ~120 lines.",

  "meta_commentary": "Execution-ready briefing. Land tasks in order \u2014 they're staged to keep each phase independently testable and to surface regressions early.\n\n**Critical landings:**\n- T1+T2 ship first (smallest blast radius, no code-path coupling).\n- T3+T4 must ship together \u2014 `_source_file` stamping is unconditional, and the strip-before-serialize in `export_to_jsonl` is what keeps the flat output byte-identical. Don't merge them separately.\n- T6+T7 are coupled (manifest writer is called from `export_to_shards`).\n- T8+T9 are coupled (push uses card v2).\n- T10 depends on T7's manifest shape.\n\n**FLAG-001 is the one technical landmine:** `huggingface_hub.HfApi.upload_folder` calls `huggingface_hub.utils.filter_repo_objects(allow_patterns=..., ignore_patterns=...)` which AND-filters \u2014 a path must be in `allow_patterns` AND NOT in `ignore_patterns`. The original `ignore_patterns=['.dataclaw/*']` would silently drop the manifest from the upload. Use `ignore_patterns=['conversations.jsonl']` ONLY. T11's `test_push_shards_manifest_survives_filter_repo_objects` calls the real `filter_repo_objects` to lock the invariant.\n\n**Byte-for-byte invariant:** T5 includes a SHA-256 comparison test for `export_to_jsonl`. If you see any drift, it's almost certainly because an underscore-prefixed key leaked into the JSON or the field ordering changed. The strip dict comprehension `{k: v for k, v in session.items() if not k.startswith('_')}` preserves Python 3.7+ insertion order \u2014 same as before.\n\n**OpenCode quirk:** Per the design, `_source_file = OPENCODE_DB_PATH` (whole DB file) \u2014 over-cools when other sessions in the DB are active, but never under-cools. Don't try to \"fix\" this to per-session mtime; T5 explicitly tests for the over-cool behavior.\n\n**Pre-existing test fragility:** T3 changes the contract \u2014 sessions with `end_time=None` are now dropped. Run the full pre-existing suite after T3 and update (don't delete) any test that seeded `end_time=None` and expected survival.\n\n**`AUTO_MODE_STEPS`:** Empty-list stub only in this plan. Phase 5 populates it. Don't reference its contents in any Phase 1\u20133 help/copy strings.\n\n**Mask scope:** Only `redact_strings` is masked by `_mask_config_for_display`. `redact_usernames` and `excluded_projects` are NOT secret-sensitive \u2014 leave them visible. `--show-secrets` flips ONLY the redact-strings masking.\n\n**Manifest path layout assumption (open question #1):** `{bucket/}{source}/{YYYY-MM-DD}.jsonl` when bucket is set; `{source}/{YYYY-MM-DD}.jsonl` otherwise. Proceed under this assumption \u2014 the plan's success criteria depend on it.\n\n**Library-only in Phases 1\u20133 (open question #2):** `export_to_shards` is NOT wired to a CLI flag in this plan. It's a library function consumed by tests now and by `dataclaw auto` in Phase 5.\n\n**Manual smoke acceptable but not required:** The OpenCode 24h-boundary REPL smoke and the masking smoke are listed as `info` priority \u2014 covered by automated tests; only run manually if a quick gut-check is desired before merging.\n\n**Watch the cli.py size:** It's already 1638 lines (DEBT flagged). This plan adds materially more behavior. Use named helpers liberally to avoid one-off ballooning of `confirm` and `export_to_shards` bodies. `export_to_shards` should stay under ~120 lines.",

  "meta_commentary": "Execution-ready briefing. Land tasks in order \u2014 they're staged to keep each phase independently testable and to surface regressions early.\n\n**Critical landings:**\n- T1+T2 ship first (smallest blast radius, no code-path coupling).\n- T3+T4 must ship together \u2014 `_source_file` stamping is unconditional, and the strip-before-serialize in `export_to_jsonl` is what keeps the flat output byte-identical. Don't merge them separately.\n- T6+T7 are coupled (manifest writer is called from `export_to_shards`).\n- T8+T9 are coupled (push uses card v2).\n- T10 depends on T7's manifest shape.\n\n**FLAG-001 is the one technical landmine:** `huggingface_hub.HfApi.upload_folder` calls `huggingface_hub.utils.filter_repo_objects(allow_patterns=..., ignore_patterns=...)` which AND-filters \u2014 a path must be in `allow_patterns` AND NOT in `ignore_patterns`. The original `ignore_patterns=['.dataclaw/*']` would silently drop the manifest from the upload. Use `ignore_patterns=['conversations.jsonl']` ONLY. T11's `test_push_shards_manifest_survives_filter_repo_objects` calls the real `filter_repo_objects` to lock the invariant.\n\n**Byte-for-byte invariant:** T5 includes a SHA-256 comparison test for `export_to_jsonl`. If you see any drift, it's almost certainly because an underscore-prefixed key leaked into the JSON or the field ordering changed. The strip dict comprehension `{k: v for k, v in session.items() if not k.startswith('_')}` preserves Python 3.7+ insertion order \u2014 same as before.\n\n**OpenCode quirk:** Per the design, `_source_file = OPENCODE_DB_PATH` (whole DB file) \u2014 over-cools when other sessions in the DB are active, but never under-cools. Don't try to \"fix\" this to per-session mtime; T5 explicitly tests for the over-cool behavior.\n\n**Pre-existing test fragility:** T3 changes the contract \u2014 sessions with `end_time=None` are now dropped. Run the full pre-existing suite after T3 and update (don't delete) any test that seeded `end_time=None` and expected survival.\n\n**`AUTO_MODE_STEPS`:** Empty-list stub only in this plan. Phase 5 populates it. Don't reference its contents in any Phase 1\u20133 help/copy strings.\n\n**Mask scope:** Only `redact_strings` is masked by `_mask_config_for_display`. `redact_usernames` and `excluded_projects` are NOT secret-sensitive \u2014 leave them visible. `--show-secrets` flips ONLY the redact-strings masking.\n\n**Manifest path layout assumption (open question #1):** `{bucket/}{source}/{YYYY-MM-DD}.jsonl` when bucket is set; `{source}/{YYYY-MM-DD}.jsonl` otherwise. Proceed under this assumption \u2014 the plan's success criteria depend on it.\n\n**Library-only in Phases 1\u20133 (open question #2):** `export_to_shards` is NOT wired to a CLI flag in this plan. It's a library function consumed by tests now and by `dataclaw auto` in Phase 5.\n\n**Manual smoke acceptable but not required:** The OpenCode 24h-boundary REPL smoke and the masking smoke are listed as `info` priority \u2014 covered by automated tests; only run manually if a quick gut-check is desired before merging.\n\n**Watch the cli.py size:** It's already 1638 lines (DEBT flagged).       "id": "T10",
      "description": "Make `confirm` directory-aware in `dataclaw/cli.py`. Argparse change (lines 1194\u20131209): add `cf.add_argument('path', nargs='?', default=None, type=Path, help='Sharded staging dir or JSONL file (default: auto-detect latest).')` and keep `cf.add_argument('--file', '-f', dest='legacy_file', type=Path, default=None, help='Deprecated alias for the positional path argument.')`. Update the dispatch at lines 1273\u20131280 to pass `path=args.path or args.legacy_file` into `confirm(...)`. Modify `confirm()` (line 941): keep parameter name `file_path` for back-compat, internally rebind. Replace `file_path = _find_export_file(file_path)` (line 952) with `mode, path, manifest = _find_export_target(file_path)`.   "meta_commentary": "Execution-ready briefing. Land tasks in order \u2014 they're staged to keep each phase independently testable and to surface regressions early.\n\n**Critical landings:**\n- T1+T2 ship first (smallest blast radius, no code-path coupling).\n- T3+T4 must ship together \u2014 `_source_file` stamping is unconditional, and the strip-before-serialize in `export_to_jsonl` is what keeps the flat output byte-identical. Don't merge them separately.\n- T6+T7 are coupled (manifest writer is called from `export_to_shards`).\n- T8+T9 are coupled (push uses card v2).\n- T10 depends on T7's manifest shape.\n\n**FLAG-001 is the one technical landmine:** `huggingface_hub.HfApi.upload_folder` calls `huggingface_hub.utils.filter_repo_objects(allow_patterns=..., ignore_patterns=...)` which AND-filters \u2014 a path must be in `allow_patterns` AND NOT in `ignore_patterns`. The original `ignore_patterns=['.dataclaw/*']` would silently drop the manifest from the upload. Use `ignore_patterns=['conversations.jsonl']` ONLY. T11's `test_push_shards_manifest_survives_filter_repo_objects` calls the real `filter_repo_objects` to lock the invariant.\n\n**Byte-for-byte invariant:** T5 includes a SHA-256 comparison test for `export_to_jsonl`. If you see any drift, it's almost certainly because an underscore-prefixed key leaked into the JSON or the field ordering changed. The strip dict comprehension `{k: v for k, v in session.items() if not k.startswith('_')}` preserves Python 3.7+ insertion order \u2014 same as before.\n\n**OpenCode quirk:** Per the design, `_source_file = OPENCODE_DB_PATH` (whole DB file) \u2014 over-cools when other sessions in the DB are active, but never under-cools. Don't try to \"fix\" this to per-session mtime; T5 explicitly tests for the over-cool behavior.\n\n**Pre-existing test fragility:** T3 changes the contract \u2014 sessions with `end_time=None` are now dropped. Run the full pre-existing suite after T3 and update (don't delete) any test that seeded `end_time=None` and expected survival.\n\n**`AUTO_MODE_STEPS`:** Empty-list stub only in this plan. Phase 5 populates it. Don't reference its contents in any Phase 1\u20133 help/copy strings.\n\n**Mask scope:** Only `redact_strings` is masked by `_mask_config_for_display`. `redact_usernames` and `excluded_projects` are NOT secret-sensitive \u2014 leave them visible. `--show-secrets` flips ONLY the redact-strings masking.\n\n**Manifest path layout assumption (open question #1):** `{bucket/}{source}/{YYYY-MM-DD}.jsonl` when bucket is set; `{source}/{YYYY-MM-DD}.jsonl` otherwise. Proceed under this assumption \u2014 the plan's success criteria depend on it.\n\n**Library-only in Phases 1\u20133 (open question #2):** `export_to_shards` is NOT wired to a CLI flag in this plan. It's a library function consumed by tests now and by `dataclaw auto` in Phase 5.\n\n**Manual smoke acceptable but not required:** The OpenCode 24h-boundary REPL smoke and the masking smoke are listed as `info` priority \u2014 covered by automated tests; only run manually if a quick gut-check is desired before merging.\n\n**Watch the cli.py size:** It's already 1638 lines (DEBT flagged). This plan adds materially more behavior. Use named helpers liberally to avoid one-off ballooning of `confirm` and `export_to_shards` bodies. `export_to_shards` should stay under ~120 lines.",

  "meta_commentary": "Execution-ready briefing. Land tasks in order \u2014 they're staged to keep each phase independently testable and to surface regressions early.\n\n**Critical landings:**\n- T1+T2 ship first (smallest blast radius, no code-path coupling).\n- T3+T4 must ship together \u2014 `_source_file` stamping is unconditional, and the strip-before-serialize in `export_to_jsonl` is what keeps the flat output byte-identical. Don't merge them separately.\n- T6+T7 are coupled (manifest writer is called from `export_to_shards`).\n- T8+T9 are coupled (push uses card v2).\n- T10 depends on T7's manifest shape.\n\n**FLAG-001 is the one technical landmine:** `huggingface_hub.HfApi.upload_folder` calls `huggingface_hub.utils.filter_repo_objects(allow_patterns=..., ignore_patterns=...)` which AND-filters \u2014 a path must be in `allow_patterns` AND NOT in `ignore_patterns`. The original `ignore_patterns=['.dataclaw/*']` would silently drop the manifest from the upload. Use `ignore_patterns=['conversations.jsonl']` ONLY. T11's `test_push_shards_manifest_survives_filter_repo_objects` calls the real `filter_repo_objects` to lock the invariant.\n\n**Byte-for-byte invariant:** T5 includes a SHA-256 comparison test for `export_to_jsonl`. If you see any drift, it's almost certainly because an underscore-prefixed key leaked into the JSON or the field ordering changed. The strip dict comprehension `{k: v for k, v in session.items() if not k.startswith('_')}` preserves Python 3.7+ insertion order \u2014 same as before.\n\n**OpenCode quirk:** Per the design, `_source_file = OPENCODE_DB_PATH` (whole DB file) \u2014 over-cools when other sessions in the DB are active, but never under-cools. Don't try to \"fix\" this to per-session mtime; T5 explicitly tests for the over-cool behavior.\n\n**Pre-existing test fragility:** T3 changes the contract \u2014 sessions with `end_time=None` are now dropped. Run the full pre-existing suite after T3 and update (don't delete) any test that seeded `end_time=None` and expected survival.\n\n**`AUTO_MODE_STEPS`:** Empty-list stub only in this plan. Phase 5 populates it. Don't reference its contents in any Phase 1\u20133 help/copy strings.\n\n**Mask scope:** Only `redact_strings` is masked by `_mask_config_for_display`. `redact_usernames` and `excluded_projects` are NOT secret-sensitive \u2014 leave them visible. `--show-secrets` flips ONLY the redact-strings masking.\n\n**Manifest path layout assumption (open question #1):** `{bucket/}{source}/{YYYY-MM-DD}.jsonl` when bucket is set; `{source}/{YYYY-MM-DD}.jsonl` otherwise. Proceed under this assumption \u2014 the plan's success criteria depend on it.\n\n**Library-only in Phases 1\u20133 (open question #2):** `export_to_shards` is NOT wired to a CLI flag in this plan. It's a library function consumed by tests now and by `dataclaw auto` in Phase 5.\n\n**Manual smoke acceptable but not required:** The OpenCode 24h-boundary REPL smoke and the masking smoke are listed as `info` priority \u2014 covered by automated tests; only run manually if a quick gut-check is desired before merging.\n\n**Watch the cli.py size:** It's already 1638 lines (DEBT flagged). This plan adds materially more behavior. Use named helpers liberally to avoid one-off ballooning of `confirm` and `export_to_shards` bodies. `export_to_shards` should stay under ~120 lines.",

  "meta_commentary": "Execution-ready briefing. Land tasks in order \u2014 they're staged to keep each phase independently testable and to surface regressions early.\n\n**Critical landings:**\n- T1+T2 ship first (smallest blast radius, no code-path coupling).\n- T3+T4 must ship together \u2014 `_source_file` stamping is unconditional, and the strip-before-serialize in `export_to_jsonl` is what keeps the flat output byte-identical. Don't merge them separately.\n- T6+T7 are coupled (manifest writer is called from `export_to_shards`).\n- T8+T9 are coupled (push uses card v2).\n- T10 depends on T7's manifest shape.\n\n**FLAG-001 is the one technical landmine:** `huggingface_hub.HfApi.upload_folder` calls `huggingface_hub.utils.filter_repo_objects(allow_patterns=..., ignore_patterns=...)` which AND-filters \u2014 a path must be in `allow_patterns` AND NOT in `ignore_patterns`. The original `ignore_patterns=['.dataclaw/*']` would silently drop the manifest from the upload. Use `ignore_patterns=['conversations.jsonl']` ONLY. T11's `test_push_shards_manifest_survives_filter_repo_objects` calls the real `filter_repo_objects` to lock the invariant.\n\n**Byte-for-byte invariant:** T5 includes a SHA-256 comparison test for `export_to_jsonl`. If you see any drift, it's almost certainly because an underscore-prefixed key leaked into the JSON or the field ordering changed. The strip dict comprehension `{k: v for k, v in session.items() if not k.startswith('_')}` preserves Python 3.7+ insertion order \u2014 same as before.\n\n**OpenCode quirk:** Per the design, `_source_file = OPENCODE_DB_PATH` (whole DB file) \u2014 over-cools when other sessions in the DB are active, but never under-cools. Don't try to \"fix\" this to per-session mtime; T5 explicitly tests for the over-cool behavior.\n\n**Pre-existing test fragility:** T3 changes the contract \u2014 sessions with `end_time=None` are now dropped. Run the full pre-existing suite after T3 and update (don't delete) any test that seeded `end_time=None` and expected survival.\n\n**`AUTO_MODE_STEPS`:** Empty-list stub only in this plan. Phase 5 populates it. Don't reference its contents in any Phase 1\u20133 help/copy strings.\n\n**Mask scope:** Only `redact_strings` is masked by `_mask_config_for_display`. `redact_usernames` and `excluded_projects` are NOT secret-sensitive \u2014 leave them visible. `--show-secrets` flips ONLY the redact-strings masking.\n\n**Manifest path layout assumption (open question #1):** `{bucket/}{source}/{YYYY-MM-DD}.jsonl` when bucket is set; `{source}/{YYYY-MM-DD}.jsonl` otherwise. Proceed under this assumption \u2014 the plan's success criteria depend on it.\n\n**Library-only in Phases 1\u20133 (open question #2):** `export_to_shards` is NOT wired to a CLI flag in this plan. It's a library function consumed by tests now and by `dataclaw auto` in Phase 5.\n\n**Manual smoke acceptable but not required:** The OpenCode 24h-boundary REPL smoke and the masking smoke are listed as `info` priority \u2014 covered by automated tests; only run manually if a quick gut-check is desired before merging.\n\n**Watch the cli.py size:** It's already 1638 lines (DEBT flagged). This plan adds materially more behavior. Use named helpers liberally to avoid one-off ballooning of `confirm` and `export_to_shards` bodies. `export_to_shards` should stay under ~120 lines.",
